instruction: Teardrop Generation The file `board.kicad_pcb` is a routed PCB with 3 footprints (R1, R2, C1), each with 2 SMD pads, and one via. No teardrops are present. The file `/home/user/Desktop/NO_TEAR.txt` lists one net name per line that must be excluded from teardrop generation. Add teardrops to every pad and via whose net is NOT listed in /home/user/Desktop/NO_TEAR.txt. Represent each teardrop as a (zone...) block with a (teardrop yes) attribute and a (filled_polygon...) child defining the teardrop shape. Requirements: 1. The output contains at least 7 teardrop zone blocks. 2. Teardrop zones exist for nets SIG_A, GND, and VCC. 3. No teardrop zones for any net listed in /home/user/Desktop/NO_TEAR.txt. 4. Each teardrop zone has a (teardrop yes) attribute and a (filled_polygon...) with at least 3 (xy...) points. 5. The original via count (1) and pad count (6) must remain unchanged. Write /home/user/Desktop/answer.kicad_pcb. [Software] To use KiCad, run `kicad` for the GUI or `kicad-cli` for scripting/headless use (use PATH or the full install path).
